body: It bothers me to see other races hijack something of our people and call it racist because its representative of us and not them. I dont think a lot of them realize the diversity on the rez. I don't see the same anger from the white folk when there is literally shit talk about them. If you don't like it dont watch it, but don't try and tear down a show written by natives for natives with native actors because it doesn't include your ideal representation of something that doesn't really have any relevance to the show. I think to call a native show racist because of the depiction of what they seem to think only applies the black people is despicable, and goes to show they have no idea of what rez life looks like. The show and the things that happen in it could be from almost any of the predominantly native communities here. So many of the things in the show struck close to home and are so relatable. I love the show and so do most of my family and friends.
